SELECT s.date, s.units_sold, i.book_on_hand_close, (s.units_sold - i.book_on_hand_close) AS shortfall
FROM store.daily_sales s
JOIN store.inventory_book i ON s.date = i.date AND s.sku = i.sku
WHERE s.sku = 'MILK-TONED-500ML' AND s.units_sold > i.book_on_hand_close
